# Security policy

## Reporting security issues

We appreciate your efforts to responsibly disclose your findings, and will make every effort to acknowledge your contributions.

Do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues, discussions or pull requests. Instead, send an email with the word "SECURITY" in the subject line to all of the following:

- [opensource.contact@orange.com](mailto:opensource.contact@orange.com)
- [cert.cc@orange.com](mailto:cert.cc@orange.com)
- the maintainers listed in [CONTRIBUTORS.md](../CONTRIBUTORS.md)

Please allow our team sufficient time to resolve the vulnerability before disclosing it. We will remain in contact about the fix and may ask for your assistance to verify that it is resolved.

We will endeavor to respond quickly, and will keep you updated throughout the process.

## What to include

- The ib-ORAN commit or release tag, and the versions of ns-3, ns3-ai, nr and Python
- A description of the vulnerability and the steps to reproduce it
- Who could exploit it and what they would gain
- Whether the vulnerability is already public or known to third parties
